commit.message: Add revision history limit to 1 for Deployment in templates

Add service account specification for enhanced security requirement

Incorporated serviceAccountName field in the Deployment spec to assign the necessary service account for enhanced security measures. This change ensures that the deployment runs with the appropriate permissions and access levels as required by recent security enhancements. No direct issues addressed in this commit.

Refactor image paths and streamline sync policies in deployment files

Simplified image paths in deployment configurations and cleaned up sync policies for smoother deployment synchronization processes.

Add github-cli orb, implement initial release in workflows, configure database environment variables, integrate Redis caching for image URLs, and modify service routing in Ingress YAML. Enhance Postgres and Redis connection handling. Improve error logging and introduce new dependencies.

Refactor branch filtering logic and job configurations

Adjust branch filtering from 'only' to 'ignore' for dev and main. Update job configurations for syncing recipes and suppliers based on new branch logic and path settings. Clean up commented-out code and unused parameters. Enhance clarity and efficiency in pipeline configurations and deployments.

Refactor secret key to accurately reflect its purpose

Corrected secret key name to better describe its content for clarity and consistency in the application.

Refactor Secret name to 'postgres-postgresql'
Adjust Secret name to 'postgres-postgresql' for clear identification and consistency.

Refactor CircleCI config and Helm charts, update values and add Terraform for EKS cluster setup

Streamlined CircleCI config by updating orbs, organized Helm charts, adjusted values, and introduced Terraform for EKS infrastructure.
